newsitem.title: CHINA: Soccer - China's Dalian unbeaten, set for title.
newsitem.headline: Soccer - China's Dalian unbeaten, set for title.

text.p: China's soccer league leaders Dalian Wanda fought back from 2-0 to draw 2-2 with hosts August First on Sunday, undefeated after the 19th round of the Chinese professional soccer league, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
August First drew ahead only three minutes into action with a dramatic own goal by Dalian Wanda's captain Xu Hong, who made the error after halting a dribble by Hao Haidong, top striker of the hosts.
Hao added the second goal for August First but one minute later Swede Patrik Svensson headed home Wanda's first goal.
Dalian Wanda dominated the game after the break, leaving no chance for August First and the equaliser came in the 62nd minute.

Defending champions Shanghai Shenhua beat visiting Guangzhou Songri 2-0, Tianjin Samsung defeated Guangdong Hongyuan 1-0, Jinan Taishan played to a 1-1 draw with Shenzhen, Guangzhou Apollo drew with Yanbian Hyundai 1-1 and Sichuan Quanxing upset Beijing Guo'an 2-0.
Dalian Wanda, topping the standings with an unmatched 41 points, are now set to win the title with two rounds to go if they can beat Jinan Taishan next week.
Guangzhou Songri and Shenzhen remain on the verge of relegation.
